drills.expected_behaviour: liveness answers 200; the process is alive and an orchestrator must not restart it for a dependency's outage
drills.injected_failure: the database is stopped or unreachable
drills.title: Liveness while PostgreSQL is unavailable

drills.expected_behaviour: readiness answers NOT_READY and names the database component, so traffic stops without the process being killed
drills.injected_failure: the database is stopped or unreachable
drills.title: Readiness while PostgreSQL is unavailable

drills.expected_behaviour: readiness answers NOT_READY and names migrations; it must not serve an assessment against a schema the build was not written for
drills.injected_failure: the database is at a revision other than the expected head
drills.title: Readiness with a migration mismatch

drills.expected_behaviour: readiness answers NOT_READY and names active_release; no assessment is performed, because an assessment with no pinned release has nothing to be traceable to
drills.injected_failure: no release is registered or activated
drills.title: Readiness with no active release

drills.expected_behaviour: liveness and readiness are unaffected and no P0 capability degrades; neither is a P0 readiness component and neither may become one
drills.injected_failure: ClinPGx and any LLM endpoint are unreachable
drills.title: External source and model outage

drills.expected_behaviour: the database volume survives, sessions created before the restart remain valid until their own expiry, and the audit chain verifies across the restart
drills.injected_failure: the application container is stopped and started
drills.title: Application restart with a persistent database

drills.expected_behaviour: in-flight requests complete within the grace period and the connection pool is disposed; a pool left open holds connections PostgreSQL will not free until they time out
drills.injected_failure: SIGTERM is delivered to the application
drills.title: Graceful stop

drills.expected_behaviour: the chain verifies, and a chain that does not is reported with the first broken sequence and no event content
drills.injected_failure: the governed audit chain is verified against stored rows
requires: at least one governed audit event
drills.title: Audit chain verification

drills.expected_behaviour: login and governed mutations are refused with RATE_LIMIT_UNAVAILABLE; the limiter fails closed, because an unmetered login path is exactly what the limiter exists to prevent
drills.title: Rate-limit backend failure

drills.expected_behaviour: the affected page reports the artifact unavailable and no partial assessment is produced; a refusal, never a partial answer
drills.injected_failure: a runtime asset named by the manifest is removed
drills.title: Missing sealed runtime artifact

drills.expected_behaviour: the governed change is rolled back; a change nobody can account for is worse than a refusal, because the refusal tells the operator something
drills.injected_failure: the audit sink raises during a governed mutation
drills.title: Governed audit append failure

drills.expected_behaviour: both image identities are recorded, the rollback happens without a database downgrade, and post-rollback liveness and readiness are observed
drills.injected_failure: the candidate image is replaced with the previous one
drills.title: Image rollback to the previous build

drills.expected_behaviour: all four runbook conditions hold: a separate target, the exact Alembic head, a verified audit chain whose count matches the separately exported head sequence, and every referenced release manifest hash resolving against restored manifests
drills.injected_failure: a backup is taken and restored into a separate database
